record.title: An’s theorem on fiberwise weighted badly approximable numbers
record.statement:
For all $s,t\ge 0$ with $s+t=1$ and all $\theta\in\mathbb{R}$ such that $\inf_{q\in\mathbb{N}}q^{1/s}\lVert q\theta\rVert>0$, the set
\[
\operatorname{Bad}(s,t;\theta):=\left\{y\in\mathbb{R}:\inf_{q\in\mathbb{N}}\max\left(q^s\lVert q\theta\rVert,q^t\lVert qy\rVert\right)>0\right\}
\]
is winning for Schmidt’s game.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/48](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15169), page 20. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Badziahin–Velani conjecture for multiplicatively badly approximable pairs
record.statement:
Let
\[
\mathrm{Mad}_\lambda=\left\{(\alpha,\beta)\in\mathbb{R}^2:\liminf_{q\to\infty}q(\log q)^\lambda\lVert q\alpha\rVert\,\lVert q\beta\rVert>0\right\}.
\]
Badziahin and Velani conjectured that \(\mathrm{Mad}_\lambda\) has full Hausdorff dimension for all \(\lambda\ge 1\), and is empty otherwise.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/48](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15169), page 31. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Counting rational points in the middle-thirds Cantor set
record.statement: Let $C$ be the middle-thirds Cantor set and define $N_C(Q)=\#\{p/q\in C:q\le Q\}$. Prove that, for every $\varepsilon>0$, $$N_C(Q)\ll_{\varepsilon}Q^{\log 2/\log 3+\varepsilon}.$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/48](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15169), page 38. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Improving the universal constant in the two-dimensional Littlewood inequality
record.statement:
For all $\alpha,\beta$, Hurwitz’s theorem gives
$$
\liminf_{q\to\infty} q\,\lVert q\alpha\rVert\,\lVert q\beta\rVert \le \frac{1}{2\sqrt{5}}.
$$
What improvement can be made to the right-hand side? One may attempt this using continued fractions. The expected value of the quantity is $0$, as predicted by the Littlewood conjecture.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/48](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15169), page 39. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Northcott property of fields generated by algebraic numbers of bounded degree
record.statement: For a positive integer $d$, let $\mathbb{Q}^{(d)}$ be the compositum of all extensions of $\mathbb{Q}$ of degree at most $d$. Does $\mathbb{Q}^{(d)}$ have Property (N), meaning that for every $X\ge 1$ the set $\{\alpha\in\mathbb{Q}^{(d)}:H(\alpha)<X\}$ is finite, where $H$ is the absolute multiplicative Weil height? The report states that this remains open for all $d\ge 3$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/49](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15170), page 21. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: DPRM analogue for rings of integers of number fields
record.statement: Is it true that, for every number field $K$, the Diophantine sets of its ring of integers $O_K$ are exactly the listable sets of $O_K$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/49](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15170), page 42. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Pop’s conjecture for finitely generated fields
record.statement: Given a finitely generated field $K$, does there exist a first-order sentence $\varphi_K$ in the language of fields such that, for every finitely generated field $L$, $\varphi_K$ holds in $L$ if and only if $K \cong L$ as fields?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/49](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15170), page 51. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Serre’s conjecture II for semisimple simply connected groups
record.statement: For every semisimple simply connected algebraic group $G$ defined over a perfect field $k$ of cohomological dimension $\operatorname{cd}(k)\le 2$, the Galois cohomology set $H^1(k,G)$ is trivial.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/5](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/14213), page 5. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Index of an orthogonal Grassmannian of a generic quadratic form
record.statement: For any even $m \ge 18$, the index of the $[m/4]$-th orthogonal Grassmannian of any generic $m$-dimensional quadratic form $\varphi/F$ in $I_q^3$ is equal to $2^{[m/4]}$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/5](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/14213), page 13. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: The permalloy problem
record.statement: Understand, from a predictive viewpoint, the particular compositions 45% Ni and 78.5% Ni (in the $\mathrm{Fe}_x\mathrm{Ni}_{1-x}$ system) at which the alloys become exceptionally soft.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/51](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15172), page 24. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Ramanujan–Petersson conjecture for cuspidal Hecke eigenforms
record.statement: Conjecture: the bound $|\lambda_f(n)|\le d(n)n^\theta$ for every $n\ge 1$ and every cuspidal Hecke eigenform $f$, holomorphic or not, remains valid when $\theta=0$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15174), page 18. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Rudin’s sumset conjecture for perfect squares
record.statement: For every positive $\\varepsilon$, there is an implicit constant such that, for every finite set $S$ of perfect squares, $|S+S|\gg |S|^{2-\varepsilon}$, where $S+S=\{s_1+s_2:s_1,s_2\in S\}$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15174), page 22. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Lamzouri’s conjecture on Gaussian limits for short character sums
record.statement:
Let $q$ tend to infinity through the primes, let $\chi(n)=\left(\frac{n}{q}\right)$ be the Legendre symbol, and let $X$ be uniformly distributed on $\{0,1,\ldots,q-1\}$. For $S_{\chi,H}(X):=\sum_{X<n\leq X+H}\chi(n)$, if $H=H(q)\to\infty$ and $H=o(q/\log q)$, then
$$
\frac{S_{\chi,H}(X)}{\sqrt H}\stackrel{d}{\longrightarrow}N(0,1)\qquad(q\to\infty).
$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15174), page 23. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: The \-torsion conjecture for class groups of number fields
record.statement: For every number field $K/\mathbb{Q}$ of degree $n$ and every integer $\ell\geq 1$, one conjectures that, for every $\varepsilon>0$, $$|\mathrm{Cl}_K[\ell]|\ll_{\varepsilon,\ell,n}D_K^{\varepsilon},$$ where $D_K=|\mathrm{Disc}_{K/\mathbb{Q}}|$ and $\mathrm{Cl}_K[\ell]=\{[\mathfrak a]\in\mathrm{Cl}_K:[\mathfrak a]^{\ell}=1\}$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15174), page 41. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Wooley’s cubic zero-count conjecture
record.statement: Let $C(x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_s)\in\mathbb{Z}[x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_s]$ be a homogeneous cubic polynomial. It is conjectured that if $s\ge 10$, then the number of solutions of $C(x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_s)=0$ with integral variables in the box $|x_i|\le B$ is $\gg B^{s-9}$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/53](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15174), page 49. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Hard-edge tacnode limit for restricted Aztec-diamond tilings
record.statement: For a uniformly random domino tiling of the Aztec diamond $A_n$ restricted to the region $y\le R$, where the horizontal line $y=R$ is tangent to the Arctic circle, the expected scaling limit of the boundary of the north polar region is the Airy$_2$ process conditioned to stay below a constant level.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/54](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15175), page 32. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Lifting a Johnson-filtration congruence to a handlebody intersection
record.statement: In the setup above, with $g\ge 3$ and $k\ge 2$, let $\phi\in A_{g,1}(k)$ and $\psi\in B_{g,1}$. Assume that for every $x\in\pi=\pi_1(\Sigma_{g,1})$, the induced automorphisms satisfy $\phi(x)\equiv\psi(x)\pmod{\Gamma_{k+1}}$. Must there exist $\mu\in AB_{g,1}$ such that, for every $x\in\pi$, $\mu(x)\equiv\phi(x)\equiv\psi(x)\pmod{\Gamma_{k+1}}$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/56](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15177), page 24. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Looijenga’s affine-open-covering conjecture for the moduli space of curves
record.statement: For every integer $g\ge 2$, the quasiprojective variety $\mathcal M_g$ of smooth genus-$g$ curves can be covered by $(g-1)$ open affine subsets.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/56](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15177), page 28. Canonicalized from 5 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Monodromy of the universal plane curve
record.statement:
For every integer $d\ge 4$, the monodromy group satisfies
\[
\Gamma_d=\operatorname{Mod}_g[\phi_d],
\qquad g=\binom{d-1}{2},
\]
where $\phi_d$ is the $(d-3)$-spin structure preserved by $\Gamma_d$ and $\operatorname{Mod}_g[\phi_d]$ is its stabilizer in the mapping class group.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/56](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15177), page 32. Canonicalized from 3 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Unbounded simplicial volume of the total spaces $E_R$
record.statement:
For each $R>0$, let $\rho_R:\pi_1(\Sigma_2)\to\operatorname{Mod}_5$ be an injective homomorphism such that the associated $\Sigma_5$-bundle $E_R\to\Sigma_2$ satisfies $\|\gamma^*E_R\|\ge R$ for every closed curve $\gamma:S^1\to\Sigma_2$. Does
\[
\lim_{R\to\infty}\|E_R\|=\infty
\]
hold?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/56](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15177), page 37. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Characterization of multigraded regularity by free Cox complexes
record.statement:
Let $M$ be a $B$-saturated $S$-module. The regularity of $M$ contains $d\in\mathbb{Z}^r$ if and only if $M(d)$ has a free Cox complex
$$F_0\leftarrow F_1\leftarrow\cdots\leftarrow F_{|\mathbf n|}\leftarrow 0,$$
such that, for every $0\leq i\leq |\mathbf n|$, the degree of each generator of $F_i$ belongs to $\Delta_i+\mathbb{N}^r$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/57](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15178), page 39. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Common refinements of factorizations of generalized power series
record.statement: For every non-zero series $a\in K((\mathbb{R}_{\le 0}))$, any two factorizations of $a$ admit common refinements.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2016/60](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15181), page 36. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Polynomial upper bound for spherical $L$-codes
record.statement: Let $L=[-1,-\beta]\cup\{\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_k\}$ for some fixed $\beta\in(0,1]$. Then there exists a constant $c_{\beta,k}$ such that any spherical $L$-code in $\mathbb{R}^n$ has size at most $c_{\beta,k}n^k$. Here a spherical $L$-code is a finite non-empty set $C$ of unit vectors in $\mathbb{R}^n$ such that $\langle x,y\rangle\in L$ for every pair of distinct vectors $x,y\in C$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/1](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15206), page 8. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: χ-boundedness of graphs excluding a fixed forest
record.statement: For every forest $H$, there exists a function $f_H$ such that $\c7(G) \le f_H(\omega(G))$ for every $H$-free graph $G$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/1](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15206), page 15. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: χ-boundedness of graphs with no long odd induced cycles
record.statement: For every $l$, the class of graphs with no odd induced cycles of length at least $l$ is $\b$-bounded.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/1](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15206), page 16. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Low-discrepancy high-dimensional permutations
record.statement:
We conjecture that permutations $X$ exist such that for every box $B\subseteq [n]^{d+1}$, where $B=\prod_{i=1}^{d+1} A_i$ and $\operatorname{vol}(B)=\prod_{i=1}^{d+1}|A_i|$, one has
\[
\bigl\lvert |X\cap B|-\operatorname{vol}(B)/n\bigr\rvert\le O\bigl(\sqrt{\operatorname{vol}(B)}\bigr).
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/1](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15206), page 41. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Kannan–Lovász–Simonovits (KLS) conjecture
record.statement:
There exists a universal constant $c>0$ such that, for every dimension $n$ and every isotropic log-concave probability measure $\bc$ on $\bb^n$, for every $S\subset\u0003bb^n$,
\[
\u0003bc^+(S)\ge c\,\u0003bc(S)\bigl(1-\u0003bc(S)\bigr),
\]
where
\[
\u0003bc^+(S)=\liminf_{\varepsilon\to0}\frac{\u0003bc(S+\varepsilon B_2^n)-\u0003bc(S)}{\varepsilon}.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/10](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15215), page 7. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Weak Thin Shell Conjecture
record.statement: There exists $c>0$ such that for every log-concave random vector $X$, for all $p\ge 1$, $$\left(\mathbb{E}|X|_2^p\right)^{1/p}\le \mathbb{E}|X|_2+c\,\sigma_p(X).$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/10](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15215), page 8. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Thin Shell Conjecture
record.statement: There exists a universal constant $c>0$ such that, for every isotropic log-concave random vector $X$ in $\mathbb{R}^n$ and every $t>0$, $$\mathbb{P}\!\left(\left|\,\lVert X\rVert_2-\sqrt n\,\right|\ge t\sqrt n\right)\le 2e^{-ct\sqrt n}.$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/10](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15215), page 9. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Variance conjecture for isotropic convex bodies
record.statement:
Does there exist an absolute constant $C>0$ such that, for every dimension $n$ and every isotropic convex body $K\subseteq\mathbb{R}^n$, if $X$ is uniformly distributed on $K$, then
$$
\operatorname{Var}|X|^2\le C\left(\sup_{\theta\in S^{n-1}}\mathbb{E}\langle X,\theta\rangle^2\right)\mathbb{E}|X|^2?
$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/10](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15215), page 17. Canonicalized from 4 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: CLT for the logarithmic volume of a full-dimensional random simplex in the cube
record.statement: Prove that, for independent uniformly distributed random vectors $X_0,\\ldots,X_d$ in $C_d=[-\\sqrt{3},\\sqrt{3}]^d$, with $\\Sigma_d^d=\\operatorname{conv}\\{X_0,\\ldots,X_d\\}$, the random variable $\\log\\operatorname{vol}_d(\\Sigma_d^d)$ is asymptotically normally distributed as $d\\to\\infty$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/10](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15215), page 24. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Uncountable strongly surjective linear orders
record.statement: Are there any strongly surjective linear orders which are not countable? Here, a linear order $L$ is strongly surjective if, for every suborder $K\subseteq L$, there is an order-preserving surjection from $L$ onto $K$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/11](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15216), page 15. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Radin forcing and special Aronszajn trees
record.statement: Is there a Radin forcing which adds a club $C\subseteq\kappa$ such that for all cardinals $\mu\in C$, there are no special $\mu^+$-Aronszajn trees?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/11](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15216), page 28. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Generalized Cichoń equalities for uncountable regular cardinals
record.statement: For every uncountable regular cardinal \\\(\kappa\) with \(2^{<\kappa}=\kappa\), both \(\operatorname{add}(\mathcal M_\kappa)=\mathfrak b_\kappa\) and \(\mathfrak d_\kappa=\operatorname{cof}(\mathcal M_\kappa)\) hold.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/11](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15216), page 36. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: A model with $d<a$ and restricted Martin’s axiom
record.statement: Can one produce a model of $d<a$ while having Martin’s axiom for all c.c.c. posets of size $<d$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/11](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15216), page 46. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Positivity of Kac polynomials for almost concealed-canonical algebras
record.statement: If $C$ is an almost concealed-canonical algebra, then the coefficients of $P_{C,d}(T)$ are non-negative for every dimension vector $d$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/12](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15217), page 70. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Bounding generic completion rank by maximum likelihood threshold
record.statement: Does there exist a function $f:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ such that, for every finite simple graph $G$, the value $f(\operatorname{mlt}(G))$ is an upper bound on its generic completion rank; equivalently, $\operatorname{gcr}(G)\leq f(\operatorname{mlt}(G))$?
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/14](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15219), page 40. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Existence of representing measures for finite-dimensional function spaces
record.statement:
Let $S$ be a topological space, let $V$ be a finite-dimensional vector space of continuous real-valued functions on $S$, let $V^*$ be its dual, and assume $Z(V)=\varnothing$. Given $L\in V^*$, does there exist a positive Borel measure $\mu$ on $S$ such that
$$
L(f)=\int_S f\,d\mu\qquad\text{for every }f\in V?
$$
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/14](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15219), page 60. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Bárány–Kalai–Meshulam connectivity conjecture for deleted joins of matroids
record.statement: **Conjecture 1 (Bárány, Kalai, and Meshulam, 2016).** For any integer $k \ge 1$ there exists an integer $n_k \ge 1$ depending only on $k$ such that for any matroid $M$ of rank $r \ge 1$ with at least $n_k$ disjoint bases, the $k$-fold deleted join $M^{*k}_{\Delta}$ of the matroid $M$ is $(kr-1)$-dimensional and $(kr-2)$-connected.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/19](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15427), page 13. Canonicalized from 4 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Conjecture on transversals for line families with the $(p,3)$-property
record.statement: Suppose $p\ge 3$ is an integer and a family of straight lines $\mathcal F$ has the $(p,3)$-property. Then there exists a point set $U$ such that $|U|\le p-2$ and $\ell\cap U\ne\varnothing$ for all lines $\ell\in\mathcal F$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/19](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15427), page 20. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Rota’s unimodality conjecture for matroids
record.statement: For every matroid, the sequence of its numbers $f_k$ is unimodal.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/19](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15427), page 30. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Homological Sperner-type theorem for rainbow simplices
record.statement: Let $K$ be a simplicial complex whose vertices are painted with the colors $I=\{1,\ldots,m\}$. For $S\subseteq I$, let $K_S$ be the subcomplex of $K$ generated by vertices whose colors belong to $S$. If $\widetilde H_{s-2}(K_S)=0$ for every subset $S\subseteq I$ consisting of $s$ colors, with $1\le s\le m$, then $K$ contains a rainbow simplex.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/19](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15427), page 31. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Upper bound for totally mixed facets of Minkowski sums of triangles
record.statement: For every integer $d\ge 2$, let $P_0,\ldots,P_{d-2}\subset\mathbb{R}^d$ be triangles whose Minkowski sum $P_0+\cdots+P_{d-2}$ is full-dimensional. Then the number of totally mixed facets of $P_0+\cdots+P_{d-2}$—facets expressible as $F_0+\cdots+F_{d-2}$ with each $F_i$ an edge of $P_i$—is at most $1+2^{d-1}$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/19](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15427), page 37. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Three-coloring homothets of a plane convex set
record.statement: For every plane convex set $D$ there is an $m$ such that any finite set of points admits a $3$-coloring such that any homothetic copy of $D$ that contains at least $m$ points contains two points with different colors.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/19](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15427), page 38. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Four-coloring homothets of convex sets in three dimensions
record.statement: For every convex set $D \subset R^3$ there is an $m$ such that any finite set of points admits a $4$-coloring such that any homothetic copy of $D$ that contains at least $m$ points contains at least two colors.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/19](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15427), page 39. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Eventual vanishing of higher extensions between \(\mathbb G_a\) and \(\mathbb G_m\)
record.statement:
Let \(\mathcal C\) be the abelian category of commutative group schemes of finite type over a fixed field \(k\). Is it true that
\[
\operatorname{Ext}^i_{\mathcal C}(\mathbb G_a,\mathbb G_m)=0
\quad\text{for all sufficiently large } i?
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15429), page 5. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Characterization of anisotropy over perfect fields by closed orbits
record.statement: Suppose that $k$ is perfect. Then $G$ is $k$-anisotropic if and only if, for every $k$-defined affine $G$-variety $W$ and every $w\in W(k)$, the orbit $G\cdot w$ is closed in $W$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/21](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15429), page 39. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Wilkie’s conjecture for sets definable in ${\mathbb R}_{\exp}$
record.statement: The Wilkie conjecture asks whether, for every set $A$ definable in ${\mathbb R}_{\exp}$, the number of rational points in the transcendental part of $A$ of height at most $H$ can be bounded polylogarithmically in $H$.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/22](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15430), page 15. Canonicalized from 1 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Volume inequalities in arbitrary structures
record.statement: Conjecture: The inequalities analogous to those in Theorem 2 (volumes of images) and Theorem 3 (volumes of pre-images) hold in arbitrary structures.
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2017/22](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/15430), page 15. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.

record.title: Sobolev sheaves on subanalytic sites for $s\geq \tfrac12$
record.statement: Let $M$ be a real analytic manifold and let $s\geq \tfrac12$. Does there exist a complex $H^s$ of sheaves, defined in the derived category of sheaves in the subanalytic Grothendieck topology on $M$, such that, for every relatively compact open Lipschitz subset $U\subset M$, $H^s(U)$ coincides with the complex concentrated in degree $0$ and equal to the classical Sobolev space $H^s(U)$?
